LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_BeautyEnhancement.label: cosmetic reshaping surgery
LanguageData.SSC_Surgery_BeautyEnhancement.descriptio:
Guide PNA through delicate surgery to give the patient a more appealing face. Mistakes leave greater pain and discomfort.
Each success improves Beauty by one step, up to Beautiful. Requires Medical 8. The patient must recover from reshaping before another treatment.
